description: National Physical Planning Development - Declare that the Area of Land Called Battaramulla Batapotha Sri Sudarshanarama Purana Viharaya as an Urban Development Area, Declare that the Area of Land Kadigamiwa Sri Nagawanarama, Raja Maha Vihara Sacred Area as an Urban Development Area, Declare that the Area Called Waduruppa Therapuththabhaya Raja Maha Vihara Sacred Area as an Urban Development Area
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land-related matters, specifically declaring certain temple lands as urban development areas under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. It contains detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and survey information for multiple properties (Battaramulla Batapotha Sri Sudarshanarama Purana Viharaya, Kadigamuwa Sri Nagawanarama Raja Maha Vihara, and Waduruppa Therapuththabhaya Raja Maha Vihara), making it clearly a land gazette. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the land declaration function rather than being about government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
